children: ), the largest theatrical exhibitor in the United States and the world, welcomed more than 4.1 million moviegoers to AMC Theatres locations in the United States and ODEON Cinemas internationally from Wednesday through Sunday, as Lionsgate’s THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING kicked off the holiday moviegoing season with an impressive opening weekend.

Led by a media-reported $225 million global opening, the film’s successful debut adds to what has been a resurgent 2026 box office all year long. Well-known movie franchises and all-new fresh movie content across a wide range of genres have been drawing immense numbers of moviegoers to theatres throughout calendar year 2026 so far. Indeed, the domestic industry box office year-to-date is running approximately $1.5 billion and more than 20% ahead of the same time period last year.

And that is just the beginning of what may be a breathtaking six-week sprint to year-end. THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING marks the first of several highly anticipated films as the industry enters its big year-end finish. All eyes are especially keenly focused on the December 18 same-day opening of both Warner Bros’ DUNE: PART THREE and Disney and Marvel’s AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY.

Adam Aron, Chairman and CEO of AMC Entertainment, commented: “We extend our sincerest congratulations to our friends at Lionsgate, to director Francis Lawrence, and to the entire cast and filmmaking team behind THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING. We are proud to have welcomed more than 4.1 million guests in our theatres, and the audience response this weekend is yet another reminder that moviegoers have been enthusiastically turning out and showing up in theatres when Hollywood brings compelling, well-made and well-marketed movies to the big screen.”

Aron continued: “What a terrific year 2026 has been for AMC. We have seen hit movie after hit movie draw hundreds of millions of guests to our theatres in the U.S. and Europe. In turn, this enabled AMC Entertainment to report record earnings in the second quarter of 2026 and then set new earnings records yet again in the third quarter of 2026. Looking ahead, we have every reason to be optimistic about the attendance we expect to see in our theatres through the remainder of the year. This should be an exceptionally exciting holiday season, as there is so much more still to come. Over the next several weeks, moviegoers can look forward to an impressive lineup of major releases, including HEXED, FOCKER IN-LAW, the IMAX-only release of THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH, DUNE: PART THREE, AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY, JUMANJI: OPEN WORLD, THE ANGRY BIRDS MOVIE 3, WERWULF and many more. What a line-up of movies coming to AMC Theatres and ODEON Cinemas.”

HEXED, FOCKER IN-LAW, and the IMAX-only release of THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH are all scheduled to open November 25 ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday weekend. DUNE: PART THREE and AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY are scheduled to open December 18, followed by JUMANJI: OPEN WORLD, THE ANGRY BIRDS MOVIE 3, and WERWULF, which all open during Christmas week.
Showtimes and tickets are available for our U.S. theatres at amctheatres.com and on the AMC mobile app.

AMC is the largest movie exhibition company in the United States, the largest in Europe and the largest throughout the world with approximately 840 theatres and 9,500 screens across the globe. AMC has propelled innovation in the exhibition industry by: deploying its signature power-recliner seats; delivering enhanced food and beverage choices; generating greater guest engagement through its loyalty and subscription programs, website, and mobile apps; offering premium large format experiences and playing a wide variety of content including the latest Hollywood releases and independent programming. For more information, visit www.amctheatres.com/.
